summary: Iteration 29 - Verified all v7 features for Siempria Conteo. Fixed critical React Hooks violation in TrendsView component (useState/useMemo called after early return). All features verified: (1) Login flow works, (2) All 7 navigation tabs functional, (3) Tendencias/Trends view with KPI cards and brand filter, (4) NOC embedded view with DealershipRows (Ranking Concesionarios), (5) NOC fullscreen 3-column layout, (6) Mobile responsive with hamburger menu and slide-out nav, (7) User management with permission chips. All 12 backend tests passed.

fixed_issues.issue: React Hooks rules violation - useState and useMemo called after early return in TrendsView component
